heading: Sunday Night
text: Mostly cloudy with rain showers ending north of Route 4, partly cloudy with a slight chance of showers south. Partial clearing with widespread fog developing, becoming dense in the valleys. Lows in the 50s. West wind diminishing overnight.

heading: Monday
text: Chance of a stray morning shower, fog burning off by mid morning becoming mostly sunny, chance of late day showers from the southwest. Highs from the mid-70s far north, increasing into the low 80s in the warmer southern valleys. Light and variable wind.

heading: Monday Night
text: Periods of clouds, with a chance of showers, mainly after midnight. Lows in the 50s to near 60.
